title: Rottweiler Dog Tags Built for Big Necks | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny engraved rottweiler dog tags, laser cut in Lehi, Utah. Saying on the front, name and number on the back. Built for big necks. From $12 a tag.
blurb: Engraved tags for the breed that guards the porch like it's Fort Knox, then climbs into your lap the second the delivery guy leaves. Strangers see a hundred pounds of muscle. You see a dog who cries when you shower without him.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: A rottweiler is hard on everything. Including the tag.
tough.html:
Rotties don't walk through life. They plow through it. They body-slam the screen door, wrestle the hose, flop onto the pool deck and shake off with enough force to rattle the whole collar.

We cut the words straight into the metal with a laser. No paint on top, no ink to fade.

Dragged through the yard, the sprinkler and every mud patch in the zip code. Still readable.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Nobody stays scared of a dog wearing "Looks scary. Wants belly rubs." Bulldogs get the same look. The tag starts the conversation and the wiggle finishes it.

sayings.h2: 8 rottweiler sayings for the dog people cross the street to avoid
sayings.lead: A funny tag fixes the neighbor's face faster than an explanation. Name and number go on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

items.q: Will drool, pool water or humidity ruin an engraved tag?
items.a: No. The words are cut into the metal with a laser, not printed on top, so there's no ink to wash off or peel away.

items.q: Can I put my rottweiler's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for rottweilers?
items.a: Eight on this page, about the guard-dog face, the lap-dog energy, the lean and the wiggle. All clean enough for the vet's office.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
